scope: Previously observed CLI help and dependency checks, plus read-only source/document review. These commands were not rerun when creating this record. No model inference or training.

commands.output_summary: Usage: run_record.py [-h] --timeout TIMEOUT --output OUTPUT ...; requires a new record directory; passes child argv after -- without shell interpretation; python -u supports timely logs.

commands.warning_summary: /home/agent/.cache/pip was not writable; pip disabled its cache for this check.

command_observation: The three commands were executed in one && chain; all three produced output and the shell returned 0, establishing successful exit for each command.

output_protection.record_directory: run_record mkdir(exist_ok=False) requires a new path, including rejection of an existing empty directory.
output_protection.experiment_directory: pretrained_image rejects an existing file/nonempty directory before verification and checks again before saving. Use a new per-request directory.
output_protection.separation: Record and experiment directories must be distinct.

budget_review.execution: One request process at a time, fixed order, no replacement samples for timeouts/failures/filtered outputs.
budget_review.recorder_wall_scope: Starts immediately before Popen and ends after child cleanup; includes child startup/imports/verification/loading/inference/output and termination grace. Recorder startup and initial metadata collection are excluded.
budget_review.driver_requirement: run_record has no multi-request budget. The driver must use one monotonic campaign clock including recorder and orchestration overhead, and record cumulative elapsed/remaining budget after each request.
budget_review.launch_rule: If the remaining campaign budget cannot accommodate a full 420-second request plus cleanup/recording reserve, do not launch it; mark remaining fixed requests not_started_budget.
budget_review.global_deadline_handling: If the global deadline requires stopping an active request, send SIGTERM to run_record early enough to permit cleanup and final recording; its child model is in a separate process group. Killing only the recorder with SIGKILL can leave running children and an unfinished running record.
budget_review.timeout_followup: Keep the timed-out request and partial outputs/logs. Continue only to the next predeclared request when remaining budget and execution conditions permit; do not rerun or substitute the timed-out request.
budget_review.limitation: The 3360-second arithmetic alone does not enforce the 3600-second driver budget because startup, metadata collection and cleanup add time.

status_review.running: Initial durable state; may remain after recorder SIGKILL/host interruption. Check live processes and logs; do not classify as successful.
status_review.succeeded: Child exit 0. Also validate metrics.json, image.png and initial_noise.npy, identities/configuration and hashes before evaluating the sample.
status_review.failed: Nonzero child exit; log is retained. Negative child_returncode means a signal; recorder exposes 128 + signal. A kill signal alone does not prove an OOM.
status_review.launch_failed: Child executable was not started; exit 127 for missing executable, otherwise 126 for launch OSError.
status_review.timed_out: timed_out=true, exit_code=124. SIGTERM is sent to the child process group; after at most a one-second grace, SIGKILL is sent and the direct child is reaped.
status_review.interrupted: Recorder received SIGINT or SIGTERM, cleans up the child group, and returns 130 or 143 respectively.

technical_and_filtering_evidence.technical_status: Read run.json status, exit_code, child_returncode, timed_out, wall_seconds and command.log; validate log_sha256/log_size_bytes when finalized.
technical_and_filtering_evidence.progress_log: DDIM step N started records entry to that UNet call, not its completion or successful output saving.
technical_and_filtering_evidence.filtering: Read metrics.json safety.checker_enabled and safety.nsfw_content_detected. A filtered request can still have succeeded/exit 0. Report it separately, retain the pipeline safety-checked image, and do not replace its prompt/seed.
technical_and_filtering_evidence.partial_output: A failed/timed-out/interrupted request may leave partial files; preserve them and the planned request position, without labeling them a complete successful result.
technical_and_filtering_evidence.successful_protocol: For each declared 512x512, 20-step request, verify unet_forward_calls=20, all unet_batch_sizes=2, branch evaluations=40, initial_noise shape=[1,4,64,64], fixed model/scheduler/configuration, and prompt truncation status.
